svg.title: What changes at scale? A P2E systems engineering schematic
svg.desc: Bench-scale reaction and separation equipment leads to an integrated pilot skid and a larger process train. The physical plant and the wireframe digital twin depict the same equipment. Five workflow stages lead to design decisions, an operating window, and a scale-up plan.

g.text: PT: Physical twin ↔ DT: Digital twin
Compare plant and model as feed or
Test load ramps and equipment design
Check the model against plant data to
find minimum load and ramp limits.
Size the limiting equipment for target output.
Verify design margins in pilot tests.
